title: What stangent-link-judge returns with claim-links on (D145)
description: The judge names claim and statement ids and copies no words. Code fills both quotes from those ids.

claims.description: The ids of the claims this answers (agree, conflict, gap). Naming one id of a line answers the whole line, unless another link names another of its ids.

page.description: A candidate page's id (agree, conflict, undocumented; optional for gap).

statement.description: The page statement's id, e.g. R3.
